verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes a well-documented public REST API surface (orders, carts, invoices, disputes, catalog) plus an open-source agent-toolkit SDK and MCP server verified live at runtime, giving AI-native users/agents a documented way to drive commerce programmatically. missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration beyond PayPal's own docs/probes, and some paths (Store Sync, ACS) are form-gated/access-restricted rather than fully self-serve.
